question: ‘Nikshay Poshan Yojana’ is a scheme introduced by the Government of India to provide nutritional support to ______ patients.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tuberculosis.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NIKSHAY POSHAN YOJANA**__

 
 
• **Nikshay Poshan Yojana** is related to **Tuberculosis.**
 
• The Patient must be registered on the **NIKSHAY Portal.**
 
• The financial incentive of Rs.** 500/- per month** for each notified TB patient.
 
• **NIKSHAY POSHAN YOJANA** is a direct benefit transfer scheme.
 
• **NIKSHAY POSHAN YOJANA** is an initiative of the** Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.**
 
• The scheme is a** centrally** sponsored scheme.
